settings.image_alt: Illustrative SuntNeew high-voltage battery system beside a home
settings.heading: Home energy storage for installers and project buyers.
settings.body: Limited German warehouse stock across high-voltage stack systems and 51.2V low-voltage systems. Share the inverter model, target capacity and postcode; we will confirm a compatible configuration and freight quote.
settings.note: B2B pricing is quoted ex VAT after compatibility, delivery postcode and unloading requirements are confirmed.

settings.title: How do I choose between G24 and G31?
settings.content: Start with the physical battery compartment and terminal layout. Both are 100Ah choices, but they use different case sizes. Confirm measurements before ordering.

settings.title: Does more Ah always mean more output?
settings.content: No. Stored energy and continuous output are different constraints. Compare both values, along with system voltage, cables, fuse requirements and the intended load.

settings.title: Which jump starter should I choose?
settings.content: Start with the supported vehicle and engine range listed on the product page, then compare portability, capacity, ports and emergency-light features.

settings.title: Where can I find certification and test information?
settings.content: Relevant model-specific safety, transport and compliance information is summarized on each product page. Contact support when you need a report or certificate for a specific model.

settings.title: Can I request a Germany home-energy-storage quote?
settings.content: Yes. Send your company details, inverter brand and model, target capacity, delivery postcode and unloading conditions. We will confirm stock, compatibility and B2B freight before quoting.
